condition: A completed synthetic anonymous turn in ordinary Chrome, followed by closing its ChatGPT tab while keeping blank tabs and Chrome running
scope: One instrumented capture after restoring the Research VM baseline; not a retention-rate estimate or a claim about secure erasure

control.method: Loopback DevTools page observation and target-list verification
control.first_close_helper_attempt: Failed before closing the ChatGPT target; a subsequent page observation confirmed the completed turn remained visible. The helper's multi-target enumeration was corrected before the scored close.

blind_process_scoped_analysis.process_selection: Active chrome.exe in image-derived windows.pslist, role from windows.cmdline; all four exact --type=renderer processes were mapped
blind_process_scoped_analysis.sse_signature_observation: One browser-parent data: prefix failed strict encoding; the other nine Chrome process maps had zero signatures

post_hoc_exact_value_diagnostic.warning: None of the seven answer-phrase hits was mapped by an active Chrome process. A later bounded context check proved that two are serialized probe textTail copies; a further exact-offset mapping check found two in vmtoolsd.exe user space and three without a process user mapping. The known-value diagnostic cannot reconstruct a linked turn, and zero exact full-response hits do not rule out differently formatted answer bytes.

later_full_physical_state_scan.method: Unchanged bounded Chrome-state grammar over the verified flat physical image, without a known prompt, answer or ID
later_full_physical_state_scan.scope: Exploratory format-specific physical scan, not process attribution or a claim that all conversation bytes were erased

screenshot.source: Actual anonymous Chrome page before tab closure; not extracted from RAM

interpretation: The frozen renderer grammar reconstructed no turn after the verified Chrome tab close. The ID and prompt had mapped copies outside the active renderers, while the answer-exclusive phrase appeared in none of the ten active Chrome user maps. Two of its seven physical hits were later identified inside the investigator's page-observation textTail, two others mapped to VMware guest-tools user space, and three had no process user mapping. None is a linked conversation or proof that Chrome retained the answer.
